question: Does your organization maintain offline, immutable, or air-gapped backups?

options.text: No backups or backups are constantly connected to the network
Backups exist online with periodic manual offline copies
Automated, air-gapped, and immutable backups are maintained regularly

question: How frequently are backup restoration drills conducted and verified?

options.text: Restoration has never been tested
Tested annually or after major infrastructure changes
Tested quarterly with verified zero-data-loss recovery targets

question: Are critical business databases and system configurations included in automated backup schedules?

options.text: Only basic files are backed up manually

options.text: MFA is not enforced or used only by IT admins
Enforced for remote access (VPN/RDP) but optional internally

options.text: Many users have local admin rights or shared superuser accounts

Automated immediate deprovisioning via central identity provider (IdP)

Micro-segmentation and strict firewall rules between user workstations and critical servers
